title: iRacing MX5 Oulton Park International Guide 1:50.8 Mazda MX5 Fixed Oulton Park Track Guide

corners.gear: back on the gas before the apex
corners.exit: can't exit any wider than that

corners.braking: briefly, sharply on the brakes to about 60%
corners.line: control the rear with the gas
turn in, get right-hand tires just on those curbs

corners.braking: midway between 100 and 50, brake to 100%, down to second, lift to first
corners.line: left-hand side, up to second, lift, back on gas, cut corner, exit wide

corners.braking: 2/3 way between turn right sign and marshals, brake to drop to second
corners.line: right hand tires over curb, exit wide
turn-in to curb, apex just on rumble strip, exit wide
corners.mistakes: can go off track if not careful

corners.braking: little dip in road, 55-60%, trail brake to 3rd gear

corners.label: T5
corners.braking: brake to 70% at end of tire wall, straight line to left
corners.line: turn-in left, apex left, right edge on exit
corners.exit: trail off, get left tires on curb edge, right tires on right edge
Get straight up to 100%, stay within track

corners.braking: Brake briefly to 45%, drop to 3rd gear, trail off
corners.line: Turn-in at white line, apex at first curve, run right tires over curbing on second curve

corners.label: T16
corners.braking: Brake briefly to 90-95%, drop to 2nd gear
corners.exit: Throttle at apex, right tires over curbing

corners.braking: Get up to 100% without ending up in the field on the left.
corners.mistakes: ending up in the field on the left

general_tips: control the rear with the gas
be careful of the tire barriers
tires are beautifully worn at end of stint
Keep right-hand tires on the right edge
